name: Jellyfin
author: jellyfin
description: Media server for films, shows and music, streamed to a browser, phone, tablet or TV on the tailnet. One container at about 200 MB, SQLite library database, no sidecar. Pinned to 12.0 — the .NET rewrite — because this library started empty, so there were no plugins to break and no database to migrate; the usual 'wait for 12.0.1' advice is for people upgrading an existing server. Transcoding is software only: the GTX 1070 cannot be used until nvidia-container-toolkit is installed. Media is mounted READ-ONLY from MEDIA_DIR in services/jellyfin/.env, which starts empty — nothing shows up until you put files there or repoint it.

control._comment: Single container with an embedded SQLite library database; nothing to order.
